svg.title: What ambition does with a task
svg.desc: Flowchart of how the ambition skill routes a task: Speed runs it as asked, a judgment call goes to best-minds, and a higher bar picks a main axis, Altitude, Depth or Range, and borrows at most one move from another axis before one rewritten prompt with an outside check.
svg.text: A task you're about to hand the AI
Ladder up, list what it needs first.
raw material, named tools, outside judge
then it stops, you decide whether to run it
